finding: Can one artifact distinguish concurrent goals, replacement and final authority? In N12, the overlay reader improves true-mechanism log loss by 0.774–3.567 nats for emergent, replacement and editor-final mechanisms when recommendations conflict, but worsens it by 0.480–0.511 nats for the unchanged author-final mechanism. At zero conflict all four mechanisms remain exactly aliased. All 12,288 cases, 204 independently reconstructed intervals, ten forecasts per setting and full replay verify. This is a constructed-mechanism result, not evidence about human authorship or authority.
